body:
Someone gets the structure and the wildness to divide the labor.

They build a strict container that makes the honest content safe: set hours for the difficult topic, a contract for the unconventional arrangement, a form for the request nobody used to be allowed to make.

With Saturn trine Lilith, the people who build containers finally build one for the content that never had a room.

So they give the banned material a room instead of a raid.

The arrangement may look tame from outside, but people who house the exile outlast people who pretend there is none.
